subject: AnySignal Investor Update - September 2025
textBody:
Hi all,

Apologies for missing these "monthly" updates for the last few.  We got
busy closing the round with Upfront back in April/May, and then had an
extremely hectic summer after we picked up a couple multi-$M contracts.

Highlights:

   - For those that weren't aware we wrapped our Series A back in - thank
   you Mark and team for the support!
   - Seeing good revenue revenue growth, hitting new records for
   monthly revenue  - $1.6M in August).  I expect Sep-Dec to be a little
   lower, but this is an indicator of the market that's there our ability to
   execute. Should be pretty amazing as we establish a more complete GTM team.
   - As revenue/production ramps, we've certainly encountered some growing
   pains as we should expect.  Everything from supply chain and logistics to
   leadership, etc.  The good news is we're pretty self-critical, good at
   reflecting on how we can improve and supported by an awesome BoD (Mark
   Suster, Arthur Karrel, David Byrd).  We've got all of the raw ingredients
   we need, and then some.
   - Bookings success continues
      - Around ~$14M booked YTD with a clear path to exceeding $20M min
      goal fot he year
      - we've been selected for two D2P2 SBIR's which is inducing good
      thought on the gov strategy.  Still need final cotnract closure/funding -
      fingers crossed
   - To help address some of the scaling challenges we're doing a good
   amount of hiring:
      - Head of Sales - late in process with some really amazing candidates
      - Head of Supply Chain - hired
      - Head of Production - choosing between two candidates this week
      - Head of Hardware - just kicking off, hoping this can reduce how
      much I get pulled into tactical things
   - Signed lease in our next manufacturing facility - 22k sqft in
   Torrance.

I'll try to do one of my long-form updates soon!

*We're delinquent in getting a proper, press-covered Series A announcement.
Happy to take help on that one. *

-John

htmlBody:
Hi all,

Apologies for missing these "monthly" updates for the last few.  We got busy closing the round with Upfront back in April/May, and then had an extremely hectic summer after we picked up a couple multi-$M contracts.

Highlights:
  • For those that weren't aware we wrapped our Series A back in - thank you Mark and team for the support!
  • Seeing good revenue revenue growth, hitting new records for monthly revenue  - $1.6M in August).  I expect Sep-Dec to be a little lower, but this is an indicator of the market that's there our ability to execute. Should be pretty amazing as we establish a more complete GTM team.
  • As revenue/production ramps, we've certainly encountered some growing pains as we should expect.  Everything from supply chain and logistics to leadership, etc.  The good news is we're pretty self-critical, good at reflecting on how we can improve and supported by an awesome BoD (Mark Suster, Arthur Karrel, David Byrd).  We've got all of the raw ingredients we need, and then some.
  • Bookings success continues 
    • Around ~$14M booked YTD with a clear path to exceeding $20M min goal fot he year
    • we've been selected for two D2P2 SBIR's which is inducing good thought on the gov strategy.  Still need final cotnract closure/funding - fingers crossed
  • To help address some of the scaling challenges we're doing a good amount of hiring:
    • Head of Sales - late in process with some really amazing candidates
    • Head of Supply Chain - hired
    • Head of Production - choosing between two candidates this week
    • Head of Hardware - just kicking off, hoping this can reduce how much I get pulled into tactical things
  • Signed lease in our next manufacturing facility - 22k sqft in Torrance.  
I'll try to do one of my long-form updates soon!

We're delinquent in getting a proper, press-covered Series A announcement. Happy to take help on that one. 

-John
